info.title: ipx IP Lookup API
info.description: Geolocation, network, time zone, locale and security data for any IPv4 or IPv6 address. IP data by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com, CC BY 4.0) and IPinfo (https://ipinfo.io, CC BY-SA 4.0).

bearerAuth.description: API key from the dashboard: `Authorization: Bearer ipx_...`

apiKeyQuery.name: key
apiKeyQuery.description: API key as a query parameter (for JSONP and quick tests).

get.summary: Look up the caller's IP address
get.description: Returns the lookup result for the IP address the request comes from. Responses are marked `Cache-Control: no-store` because they depend on the caller.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `ip,location.country,security`. A group name (`location`) returns the whole group; `success` is always included.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for continent and country names: en (default), de, es, fr, ja, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, fa, ko. Unknown values fall back to English. City and region names are English only.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback name (letters, digits, `_`, `$`, `.`). The response becomes `callback({...});` and is always sent with HTTP 200, errors included.

200.description: Lookup result for one IP address.

success.description: Always true for a successful lookup.

ip.description: The IP address, normalized (IPv6 compressed, IPv4-mapped IPv6 as IPv4).

reserved.description: True for private, loopback, link-local, multicast, documentation and other reserved ranges. Location, network and locale fields are then null.

continent_code.description: Two-letter continent code: AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC or SA.

is_eu.description: Whether the country is a member state of the European Union.

region.description: First-level subdivision (state, province, region). English only.

postal.description: Postal code. Always null with the free data sources.

location.description: Where the IP address is registered or used.

is_dst.description: Whether daylight saving time is in effect right now.

current_time.description: Current local time in ISO 8601 format with offset.

timezone.description: Time zone at the location, computed per request.

as_name.description: Name of the organization that operates the AS.

as_domain.description: Primary domain of the AS operator.

network.description: The autonomous system that announces the IP.

currency.description: Main currency of the country, or null when unknown.

languages.description: Official or main languages of the country; empty when unknown.

locale.description: Country facts derived from the country code.

is_tor.description: Whether the IP is a current Tor exit node.

is_proxy.description: Whether the IP is a known open or residential proxy. Always false with source "basic".

is_vpn.description: Whether the IP belongs to a VPN service. Always false with source "basic".

is_hosting.description: Whether the IP is in a published cloud or hosting provider range.

hosting_provider.description: Provider whose published ranges contain the IP.

source.description: Which security dataset produced these flags. "basic" = public Tor and cloud lists only.

security.description: Risk signals merged from public IP lists.

schema.description: Lookup result for one IP address.

post.summary: Look up up to 100 IP addresses
post.description: Needs an API key. Each address counts as one lookup against the monthly quota. Invalid addresses do not fail the request; they get an item with `success: false`.

ips.description: IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses to look up (1 to 100).
